title: Motoswap / VampChef — proxied MasterChef + locked MOTO staking + UniV2 AMM
closed_reasons: VampChef deposit/append/harvest/withdraw/emergencyWithdraw accounting is correct; a new stake or append gets rewardDebt = amount*acc/PREC, so no retroactive rewards
VampChef depositFor cannot top up another user's existing position; recoverUndistributedRewards is owner-only
MotoStaking stake/append set userRewardDebt correctly; pendingReward is 0 immediately after a fresh stake and after append
MotoStaking claimReward reverts OwnableUnauthorizedAccount for a random caller; claimTokenSelf reverts OnlySelf; available() = 0 immediately after stake (principal vests)
20/20 Motoswap AMM pairs have balanceOf(pair) == getReserves(); skim surplus is 0
MOTO balance is ~99.8% accounted: 998.839M raw stake + 1.140M unstake tickets + 1.076M rewards + ~2.1M dust/unenumerated
key_facts: VampChef: 60 pools; MOTO pool pid 1 allocPoint 0 lpSupply 569,620,424.511779337789789732; rewardBudget 300M; emission ended 1,790,624,687; totalCredited 289,013,640.381895332390360189; totalHarvested 285,476,610.056944695923774867; availableReward 14,523,389.943055304076225133; recoverableReward 10,986,359.618104667609639811 (owner-only after 2026-10-29)
Motoswap factory 0x81c9cbc47d700da1777abd831d8da3f526dfae24: 20 pairs, swapFeeBps 30, feeTo 0, swapAllowed(router/FeeRouter)=true; no pair has skim surplus
MOTO price $0.0001271 on Dexscreener; user principal 1,568.459M MOTO is ~$199k nominal but exit liquidity is thin (main pair 3.57 WETH)
Foundry fork tests 6/6 pass: no retroactive stake/append rewards; claimReward/claimTokenSelf self/owner-only; available()=0 immediately after stake; VampChef public paths pay 0 to non-stakers
Enumerated 537 stakers: sum positions + claimableUnstaked = 999.978M MOTO; balance 1,003.203M; difference 1.076M rewardOwed + ~2.15M dust/unenumerated (0.2%)
caveats: MOTO price is thin/illiquid; the H-O USD excludes user principal (1.568B MOTO) and LP tokens, which are nominal at market price
VampChef owner is a single EOA and both proxies are upgradeable; MotoStaking's upgrade authority has getMinDelay()=0 (no observed timelock)
MotoStaking implementation is unverified; behaviour is covered by the tested selectors, not source review
The MOTO pool has allocPoint 0 (no new MOTO emissions) and claimAsMoto is not live; design choices, not leaks
Point-in-time reads at Ethereum block 26,217,720; fork tests pinned at 26,217,377
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract ~$0 live from Motoswap/VampChef: stake/append accounting is correct, claim paths are self/owner-only, principal vests, and all 20 AMM pairs have zero skim surplus.
